# railway_project_token (Resource)

Railway project token. Project tokens cannot be updated, changing any attribute replaces the token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "railway_project_token" "example" {
  name           = "example"
  project_id     = railway_project.example.id
  environment_id = railway_project.example.default_environment.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) Identifier of the environment the project token has access to.
- `name` (String) Name of the project token.
- `project_id` (String) Identifier of the project the project token belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the project token.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Value of the project token. Only available when created by Terraform, it is not populated on import.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import railway_project_token.example 89fa0236-2b1b-4a8c-b12d-ae3634b30d97:227bc195-52fa-4d39-a872-a8cec0a0feca
```
